title: Ireland – Infrastructure works consultancy services – Portdoon Harbour on Inishturk Island Mayo, Environmental Scoping Document and Feasibility Study - Mayo County Council
description: The purpose of this Tender is to undertake an Environmental Scoping Document and Feasibility Study for Portdoon Harbour, Inishturk Island, Co. Mayo, and to assess opportunities for the sustainable enhancement of the harbour and its surrounding environment, including the potential development of a walking trail linking the harbour to the nearby beach. Throughout the study, the Consultant shall have regard to the needs of the Islands ageing population and shall apply age-friendly design principles to all recommendations relating to accessibility, public realm improvements, visitor facilities, community amenities and recreational infrastructure. Opportunities to enhance accessibility, inclusivity and ease of use for older persons and those with reduced mobility shall be identified and incorporated wherever feasible and appropriate. Portdoon Harbour serves as the principal gateway to Inishturk Island and plays a vital role in supporting island residents, visitor access, tourism activity and essential services. The study will examine the existing harbour infrastructure, access arrangements, visitor facilities and environmental constraints, while identifying opportunities to improve the visitor experience, accessibility, connectivity and overall functionality of the harbour. The project area is located within a highly sensitive coastal and island environment of significant ecological, landscape and cultural value. Consequently, all recommendations arising from this commission must be informed by the principles of environmental stewardship, sustainable development, climate resilience and the protection of the island's natural and built heritage.

title: Hazardous Waste Removal, Disposal, and Recycling at Diego Garcia
description: For the Removal and Off-Site Disposal of Hazardous and Recyclable Wastes Located Diego Garcia Who � Defense Logistics Agency (hereinafter DLA) on behalf of US Military activities located at Diego Garcia in the British Indian Ocean Territory. What � DLA has a 5-year contract requirement for the removal and off-site disposal of regulated and non-regulated wastes generated by US military operations. Wastes will be properly packaged and loaded onto Cargo Transport Units (CTU) for marine vessel transport to the US or EU for disposal and/or recycling. Wastes include but are not limited to regulated flammables, corrosives, toxics, and recyclable batteries and automotive fluids. The awarded company will: Identify preferred waste disposal and recycling facilities, having them pre-vetted for inclusion on the DLA Qualified Facilities List (QFL) at https://www.dla.mil/Disposition-Services/Offers/Hazardous-Waste-Disposal/Qualified-Facilities-List/, Prepare Basel Convention and other documents for transboundary movements as applicable, Prepare shipping documents for transportation to/in the Host Nation where disposal and recycling is completed, Ensure all wastes are packaged according to IMDG Code and other applicable transportation laws and regulations, Prior to shipment, with a US Government representative, perform pre-shipment inspection of all containers to verify suitability for transport via marine vessel, Transport loaded CTUs to pier side transfer facility and oversee loading onto contractor chartered marine transport vessel, Oversee DLA Qualified Transporter contractor chartered marine transport vessel logistics en route, Oversee unloading of CTUs from marine transport vessel and transport via ground to destination DLA Qualified Facility, Ensure all wastes are properly disposed or recycled, and Provide DLA with supporting documentation to certify tracking of waste and completion of work. Removal quantities will vary. Current inventory exceeds 168 tons in 16 loaded CTUs. A DLA Qualified Facility is a treatment, storage, disposal and/or recycling facility that has demonstrated to DLA a sufficient historical record of safety, operational, and regulatory compliance standards. Interested companies must be qualified and credentialed to handle hazardous material and hazardous waste (HM/HW) at both the loading and unloading locations. Interested companies should indicate whether they can provide initial packaging services to place waste in UN rated drums and other containers purchased by the US Government, then loaded into CTUs for marine vessel transportation, as well as charter the marine vessel for transportation to final destination. Where � Waste will be removed from the US military base, Diego Garcia, and transported to the US or EU for disposal/recycling. When � Removals will be performed annually over a 5-year performance period having a 30-month base period and 30-month option period. Why � DLA Disposition Services is requiring responsible disposal and recycling of regulated and non-regulated hazardous and recyclable wastes in support of operations at Diego Garcia. Submit information and any questions to kayla.desvoignes@dla.mil and daniel.schuemann@dla.mil with "Request for Information Hazardous Waste Diego Garcia" in the subject line.

title: Syväkeräysastioiden vuosihuollot / VAV
description: Syväkeräysastioiden vuosihuollot / VAV Tilaajan tavoitteena on hankkia joustava ja luotettava yhteistyökumppani Vantaalla sijaitsevien VAV-konsernin omistamien vuokratalokohteiden syväkeräysjätepisteiden vuosihuoltoihin. VAV-konserni omistaa noin 12 000 vuokra-asuntoa, joissa asuu noin 19 000 asukasta. Tarkempi luettelo sopimuksen piiriin kuuluvista syväkeräyskohteista on tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevassa kohdeluettelossa. Sopimus ei sisällä määräostovelvoitetta, eikä Tilaaja sitoudu tarjouspyynnössä tai hankintailmoituksessa esitettyihin arvioihin hankintamääristä. Työtilauksiin voi sisältyä myös tarvikehankintoja ja muita työn suorittamiseen liittyviä palveluhankintoja. Tavoitteiden saavuttamisen edellytykset on kerrottu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön ESPD-lomakkeella, hankinnan kohteen kriteerit -osiossa sekä hankintailmoituksen liitteissä. Hankintapäätöksen tekoperusteena on kokonaistaloudellinen edullisuus pisteytyksen mukaisesti, jossa maksimipisteet ovat 1000 pistettä. Tarjoajan on annettava tarjous kaikista tarjouslomakkeen töistä. Mikäli Tarjoaja ei ole tarjonnut kaikkia tarjouslomakkeeseen eriteltyjä töitä, tulkitaan tarjous puutteelliseksi. Puutteellinen tarjous hylätään. Tarjoajan kannalta huomioitavaa on myös se, että tarjottujen töiden ja hintojen tulee sisältää kaikki tässä tarjouspyynnössä, hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ja palvelukuvauksessa määritellyt kriteerit. Palvelu toteutetaan tarjouspyynnön, palvelukuvauksen ja laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti. Tarjoajan antama tarjous on sitova. Hankintasopimus syntyy vasta kirjallisen sopimuksen allekirjoittamisella, selonottoneuvottelujen jälkeen. description: The Finnish Border Guard (later also Contracting Authority) is launching a restricted procurement procedure for the procurement of small unmanned aircraft systems (hereinafter referred to as the UAS) and is inviting suppliers to request participation. This Request for Participation alongside its appendices sets out general requirements for the unmanned aircraft system (hereinafter referred to as the system) and the unmanned aircraft (hereinafter referred to as the UAV) to be procured. More detailed requirements will be presented in the Call for Tenders, which will be published later. The Finnish Border Guard's unmanned aviation is civil aviation that complies with the provisions of the Aviation Act (864/2014) and Traficom OPS M1-35 State Unmanned Aviation. The operations may deviate from the EASA drone regulations, taking into account the flight safety definitions of the 'specific' category. In addition, the operations of unmanned aircraft comply with the provisions and instructions of the Border Guard's permanent documents. The Finnish Border Guard uses unmanned aerial vehicles to perform statutory tasks on land and at sea. Unmanned aerial vehicles may be used in crime prevention, maritime rescue, special forces operations or in support of other authorities, for example in the search for a missing person. Unmanned aerial vehicles may also be used in other operational tasks as well as in research, development, education, training and communication activities. Interested candidates are requested to attach brochures of the proposed systems in their request to participate. If the product in the brochure does not meet the requirements stated in this Request for Participation, the participant may be excluded from the tendering phase. After submitting the tenders, the Finnish Border Guard may request tenderers to submit a test version of the proposed UAS to verify the requirements set out in the Call for Tenders. The total estimated value of this procurement is 450 000 €.

BACKGROUND AND SCOPE The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), MH-139A Program Office (AFLCMC/WIH), is conducting market research to identify sources capable of providing Parallel Battery Relay modification for the MH-139A. The MH-139A missions routinely require off-station engine starts using only battery power. Flight data indicates that isolated battery starts in extreme cold weather degrade transient voltage, resulting in failed or hot engine starts. The objective of this effort is to modify the aircraft to parallel the main and auxiliary batteries during start sequences to prevent engine damage in austere environments. Critical Exclusion (Batteries): The USAF currently possesses compatible Nickle-Cadmium 44 Ah Main and 27 Ah Auxiliary batteries.[CA1] [BA2] [JC3] Modification pricing must strictly exclude the physical batteries and include only the installation hardware (relays, brackets, wiring, consumables). Support & Documentation: The vendor must provide the necessary technical data package (e.g., flight manual supplements, wiring diagrams, structural data, and software integration files) associated with their kit to allow the Government to integrate the modification into baseline aircraft and training devices. 3.
